function.description: End an order's fulfillment: record the proof, write the receipt and tell the buyer (or failed=true with the reason). Only the order's own run or the owner.
function.name: order_deliver

failed.description: True when the deliverable could not be made.

message.description: A short note for the buyer.

proof.description: tx_receipt: {tx_hash}; file_hash: {sha256}; url: {url}. Optional media_paths: files sent to the buyer.
